### Loading in data and packages
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)

sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here(
  "eds223-lab-disc/",
  "data",
  "week3_data",
  "cpad_super_units_sb.shp"
)) |>
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here(
  "eds223-lab-disc/",
  "data",
  "week3_data",
  "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp"
)) |>
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here(
  "eds223-lab-disc/",
  "data",
  "week3_data",
  "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp"
)) |>
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

aves <- st_read(here(
  "eds223-lab-disc/",
  "data",
  "week3_data",
  "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp"
)) |>
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")
```

### 2. Find bird observations within PAs in Santa Barbara County

- Subset and Join bird observation data
```{r}
birds_protected_join <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas) # spatial join

birds_protected_subset <- sb_protected_areas[aves, ] # spatial subset

tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(sb_city_boundaries) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(birds_protected_subset) + # change this one to switch between subset and join
  tm_dots()
```

- Make 5km buffer around the brotected areas and subset birds to bufferred region

```{r}
pa_5km_buffer <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = units::set_units(5, "km"))

tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(sb_city_boundaries) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(pa_5km_buffer[aves, ]) +
  tm_dots()
```

### 3. Find PAs within 15km of Goleta
- Find the protected areas within 15km of a city in SB County

```{r}
goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> filter(NAME == 'Goleta')
goleta_15km_buffer <- st_buffer(goleta, dist = units::set_units(15, "km"))

goleta_PAs_within <- st_within(sb_protected_areas, goleta_15km_buffer) # logical
goleta_PAs_intersects <- st_intersects(sb_protected_areas, goleta_15km_buffer) # logical
goleta_PAs_intersection <- st_intersection(
  sb_protected_areas,
  goleta_15km_buffer
) # new geometry


tm_shape(goleta_PAs_intersection) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_borders()

pa_join_goleta <- st_join(
  sb_protected_areas,
  goleta,
  st_is_within_distance,
  dist = units::set_units(15, "km")
)
```

### 4. Find distance between Goleta and Dangermond Preserve

```{r}
# Subset PA to Dangermond Preserve
dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |>
  dplyr::filter(UNIT_NAME == "Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve")
```


```{r}
danger_dist <- st_distance(goleta, dangermond) # Compute the distance between geometries edges
```
